name: STAR Statistics — summary statistics, correctly rounded
summary: Mean, sample and population variance and standard deviation, root mean square and weighted mean computed exactly in rational arithmetic and rounded once, independent of the order of the values; on 500 datasets all seven statistics are identical to mpmath at 400 digits rounded once and to CPython's statistics module where it has them; reproduces the NIST NumAcc1 and NumAcc2 reference datasets.
reference: NIST Statistical Reference Datasets, NumAcc2 (1.2 followed by 500 pairs 1.1, 1.3): certified mean 1.2, sample standard deviation 0.1; NumAcc1 (10000001, 10000003, 10000002): mean 10000002, standard deviation 1
reference_observed: mean = 1.2 and stdev = 0.09999999999999998 (the exact statistic of the floats 1.1, 1.2, 1.3); mean = 10000002.0 and stdev = 1.0

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: sample statistics by default (divisor n - 1), population with sample=False
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; what 'exact' means for floats that stand for decimals is stated; the overlap with the standard statistics module is stated
